name: Open Reaction Database (ORD)
description: Open-access schema, infrastructure, and centralized repository for structured single-step organic reaction data, spanning benchtop reactions, high-throughput experiments, and flow chemistry. Built to support machine learning for reaction prediction and synthesis planning; contains hundreds of thousands of reactions contributed by academic and industrial groups.
associated_paper: Kearnes et al., The Open Reaction Database, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2021

name: USPTO Chemical Reactions (Lowe)
description: Text-mined collection of ~1.8 million organic reactions extracted from US patents (1976-Sep 2016) by Daniel M. Lowe, provided as reaction SMILES/CML. The de facto open reaction corpus underlying most retrosynthesis and reaction-prediction ML models.
associated_paper: Lowe, Chemical reactions from US patents (1976-Sep2016), Figshare 2017

name: Buchwald-Hartwig C-N Cross-Coupling HTE Dataset
description: High-throughput experimentation dataset of ~3,955 Pd-catalyzed Buchwald-Hartwig C-N cross-coupling reactions measuring yield across combinations of aryl halides, Buchwald ligands, bases, and isoxazole additives. Generated by nanomole-scale HTE in multiwell plates; a canonical benchmark for reaction-yield prediction.
associated_paper: Ahneman, Estrada, Lin, Dreher, Doyle, Science 360:186-190 (2018)

name: Suzuki-Miyaura Coupling HTE Dataset (Perera/AstraZeneca)
description: Dataset of 5,760 Pd-catalyzed Suzuki-Miyaura couplings screened on an automated nanomole-scale flow platform, varying electrophile, nucleophile, ligand, base, and solvent with LC-MS yield readouts (>1500 reactions/day). Widely used flow-chemistry HTE benchmark for yield prediction.
associated_paper: Perera et al., Science 359:429-434 (2018)

name: QM9
description: Computed geometric, energetic, electronic, and thermodynamic properties (19 quantum-chemical properties at B3LYP/6-31G(2df,p)) for ~134k stable small organic molecules (up to 9 heavy atoms, CHONF) drawn from GDB-17. The foundational benchmark for geometric deep learning on molecules.
associated_paper: Ramakrishnan, Dral, Rupp, von Lilienfeld, Sci. Data 1:140022 (2014)

name: QM7 / QM8
description: QM7: 7,165 small organic molecules (up to 7 heavy atoms, from GDB-13) with Coulomb matrices and DFT atomization energies. QM8: TD-DFT/CC2 low-lying electronic excitation energies and oscillator strengths for ~21,786 molecules. Standard quantum-chemistry ML benchmarks hosted on quantum-machine.org.
associated_paper: Rupp et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 2012 (QM7); Ramakrishnan et al., J. Chem. Phys. 143:084111 (2015) (QM8)

name: ANI-1x / ANI-1ccx
description: ~5 million off-equilibrium molecular conformations with DFT (wB97x/6-31G(d)) properties, generated via active learning; ANI-1ccx adds coupled-cluster (CCSD(T)) reference data. Designed to train transferable neural-network interatomic potentials for organic molecules.
associated_paper: Smith et al., The ANI-1ccx and ANI-1x data sets, Sci. Data 7:134 (2020)

name: MoleculeNet
description: Curated benchmark suite of 17 public datasets across four property categories (quantum mechanics, physical chemistry, biophysics, physiology) covering >700,000 compounds, with standardized splits and metrics. Distributed via the DeepChem open-source library.
associated_paper: Wu et al., MoleculeNet: a benchmark for molecular machine learning, Chem. Sci. 9:513 (2018)

name: ESOL (Delaney Aqueous Solubility)
description: Regression dataset of measured aqueous solubility (log mol/L) for 1,128 organic compounds paired with SMILES structures, from Delaney's ESOL study. A small, widely used experimental solubility benchmark (also part of MoleculeNet).
associated_paper: Delaney, ESOL: Estimating Aqueous Solubility Directly from Molecular Structure, J. Chem. Inf. Comput. Sci. 44:1000 (2004)

name: FreeSolv
description: Curated database of experimental and calculated hydration (solvation) free energies for 643 neutral small molecules in water, with SMILES, experimental references, and alchemical MD-calculated values plus input files. Maintained by the Mobley Lab.
associated_paper: Mobley & Guthrie, FreeSolv, J. Comput. Aided Mol. Des. 28:711 (2014)

name: PubChem
description: NIH/NCBI public repository of chemical information organized as three linked databases: Substance, Compound (~100M+ unique structures), and BioAssay (experimental screening results). Aggregates deposited experimental data, measured properties, and computed descriptors from hundreds of sources.
associated_paper: Kim et al., PubChem 2023 update, Nucleic Acids Res.

name: ChEMBL
description: Manually curated database of bioactive drug-like small molecules from the medicinal-chemistry literature, patents, and screening, with measured bioactivities (Ki, Kd, IC50, EC50) against biological targets. Maintained by EMBL-EBI; v34 contains millions of activity records.
associated_paper: Zdrazil et al., The ChEMBL Database in 2023, Nucleic Acids Res. 2024

name: BindingDB
description: Public FAIR knowledgebase of experimentally measured protein-small molecule binding affinities (~2.9M measurements over ~1.3M compounds and thousands of targets), curated chiefly from the literature and patents. Focused on drug-target interactions for SAR/QSAR and computational validation.
associated_paper: Gilson et al., BindingDB in 2024, Nucleic Acids Res. 53:D1633 (2025)

name: Tox21
description: Toxicology-in-the-21st-Century dataset of ~12,000 compounds profiled by quantitative high-throughput in vitro assays across 12 nuclear-receptor and stress-response endpoints (EPA/NIH/FDA collaboration). Basis of the Tox21 Data Challenge and a standard toxicity-prediction benchmark.
associated_paper: Huang et al.; Tox21 10K Compound Library, Chem. Res. Toxicol. 2021

name: NIST Chemistry WebBook (SRD 69)
description: NIST Standard Reference Database of evaluated experimental thermochemical, ion-energetics, and spectroscopic data: reaction thermochemistry for >8000 reactions, IR spectra for >16,000 compounds, mass spectra for >33,000 compounds, plus UV/Vis and other data. Free to browse and search.
associated_paper: Linstrom & Mallard, The NIST Chemistry WebBook, J. Chem. Eng. Data 46:1059 (2001)

name: nmrshiftdb2
description: Open-data, open-source web database of organic structures with assigned experimental NMR chemical-shift lists (13C, 1H, and other nuclei) and metadata, supporting spectrum prediction and structure/substructure search. Data downloadable under an open-content license.
associated_paper: Kuhn, Twenty years of nmrshiftdb2, Magn. Reson. Chem. 2024

name: Spectral Database for Organic Compounds (SDBS)
description: Free searchable spectral database from Japan's AIST covering ~34,000 organic compounds with six measured spectrum types: EI mass spectra, FT-IR, 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, laser Raman, and EPR. Access is free but requires agreeing to a usage disclaimer.

name: MassBank Europe
description: Open, FAIR mass-spectral library for identifying small molecules of metabolomics, exposomics, and environmental relevance, holding ~120,000 (mostly high-resolution) experimental spectra for ~18,500 compounds from dozens of contributors. Cross-integrated with PubChem, MoNA, and the EPA CompTox Dashboard.
associated_paper: Horai et al., MassBank, J. Mass Spectrom. 45:703 (2010)

name: Cambridge Structural Database (CSD)
description: Curated repository of experimentally determined small-molecule organic and metal-organic crystal structures (>1,000,000 entries, ~40,000 added/year), maintained by CCDC. NOT fully open: individual depositions are free to view/download via Access Structures, but full search and analytics require a subscription.
associated_paper: Groom et al., The Cambridge Structural Database, Acta Cryst. B72:171 (2016)

name: CALiSol-23
description: Curated open dataset of 13,825 experimentally measured ionic-conductivity data points for non-aqueous lithium-battery electrolytes, digitized from 27 publications and covering 14 Li-salts, 38 solvents, varied concentrations, and temperatures. Each point is expert-ratified and source-referenced.
associated_paper: CALiSol-23: Experimental electrolyte conductivity data, Sci. Data 11 (2024)

name: The Photoswitch Dataset
description: Curated molecular ML benchmark of experimentally measured photophysical properties for azobenzene-type molecular photoswitches, including electronic transition wavelengths, thermal isomerization rates, and photostationary states. Built to accelerate data-driven photoswitch discovery.
associated_paper: Griffiths et al., Data-driven discovery of molecular photoswitches, Chem. Sci. 13:13541 (2022)

name: Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC)
description: Unified open platform of 66 ML-ready datasets across 22 learning tasks (~16M data points) spanning target discovery, ADMET, efficacy, safety, and manufacturing for small molecules, antibodies, and vaccines. Provides splits, evaluators, oracles, and leaderboards via an open Python library.
associated_paper: Huang et al., Therapeutics Data Commons, NeurIPS 2021 Datasets & Benchmarks

name: Open Graph Benchmark - Molecular Datasets
description: Standardized graph-ML benchmark datasets for molecular property prediction, notably ogbg-molhiv (41,127 molecules, HIV-inhibition classification) and ogbg-molpcba (437,929 molecules, 128 PubChem BioAssay tasks). Molecules are RDKit-processed with unified atom/bond features and scaffold splits.
associated_paper: Hu et al., Open Graph Benchmark, NeurIPS 2020

name: ZINC20
description: Free ultralarge database of commercially available (purchasable/make-on-demand) compounds in ready-to-dock 3D formats, exceeding 230 million molecules with fast similarity and substructure search. Curated as a real, orderable chemical catalog; 3D conformers and properties are computed.
associated_paper: Irwin et al., ZINC20, J. Chem. Inf. Model. 60:6065 (2020)
